name: Kurama Jonin
condition_immunities: Charmed, Demoralized, plus mind alteration and control

entries.name: Adept Elementalist
entries.text: You gain resistance to psychic damage and increase your psychic damage by +1 damage die.

entries.name: Genjutsu Conversion
entries.text: You can use your Genjutsu DC, attack bonus, and ability score for Ninjutsu of C-Rank or lower.

entries.name: Indomitable
entries.text: You are immune to any effects that would alter your mind or will. This includes Charmed and Fear. You cannot be mind-controlled or influenced by external forces.

entries.name: Jutsu of War
entries.text: Each time you cast a jutsu, you can make an additional weapon attack or Mind Sliver attack as part of the same action used to cast the jutsu.

entries.name: Layered Genjutsu
entries.text: When a creature under the effects of your Genjutsu succeeds on a saving throw, you can use your reaction to cast a second Genjutsu on the same creature.

entries.name: Sure-Footed
entries.text: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws and ability checks.

This adversary has the unstoppable power of Fiction to Fact. By spending 1 Tenacity die, this adversary can turn one jutsu it casts into a Genjutsu, changing its saving throw, if any, into a Wisdom save.

entries.name: Elite Striker (Genjutsu)
entries.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Genjutsu and weapon attack bonuses. Also, increase the number of weapon attacks by 1 (added).

entries.name: Striker (Genjutsu) Passive 1
entries.text: Once per turn, your Genjutsu damage triggers any conditional damage a creature may be suffering from.

entries.name: Striker (Genjutsu) Passive 2
entries.text: Once per turn, your Genjutsu damage ignores temporary hit points.

entries.name: Striker (Genjutsu) Action
entries.text: By spending 4 Tenacity dice, this adversary can Overpower the next Genjutsu it casts. The overpowered jutsu adds the Tenacity die to its damage and imposes a 1d4 penalty on creatures forced to make a saving throw against the jutsu cast. Additionally, if the jutsu cast scores a critical hit, increase the attack's damage die by 1 step.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Kurama Jonin may make four attacks with its currently equipped weapon or two Mind Sliver attacks.

entries.name: Kunai
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Mind Sliver
entries.text: Ranged Genjutsu Attack: +11 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or suffer a 1d4 penalty on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.

The Kurama Jonin takes one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn, once each round, to either move, attack, cast a jutsu, or spend its Elite Action to gain an additional reaction. It regains spent Elite Actions at the beginning of each of its turns.
The Kurama Jonin's Ninjutsu of C-Rank and below are cast as Genjutsu.

notes: The Multiattack is printed as "The Kurama Chunin may make four attacks"; corrected to the Kurama Jonin. The Jutsu Note is a footnote printed under the Ninjutsu list.
